passages.excerpt_preview: ehangir Ratanji Dadabhoy Tata was born in Paris on 29 July 1904.

passages.locator: criticism of aspects of India’s controlled economy
passages.excerpt_preview: The exhibition also records his criticism of aspects of India’s controlled economy and praises his standards of integrity in business.

passages.locator: became head of the Tata group at age thirty-four
passages.excerpt_preview: He spent more than seventy years of working life in India and became head of the Tata group at age thirty-four.
He chaired Tata Sons from 1938 for more than half a century and supported the creation of new enterprises.
Tata Central Archives credits him with pioneering civil aviation, supporting Homi Bhabha and the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, and promoting family planning.
